items.title: 2nd or 3rd Startup Conversation
items.hook: "what's the smallest thing I could implement?"
items.description:
2026-08-23, 6:26pm.
Worked out basic things that the Today cockpit focuses on: Orientation, Direction, Operations, and Witness.  And then we talked about minimal implementation.  This turned into a basic framing for the app.

items.title: Dividing into 3 Parts
items.description:
Started with: 1. Panels 2. Interaction Model, 3. Multi-threading, 4. Fair Play.
But discovered Aug 25th, that 3&4 need to become a different model for memory and disk access, and Fair Play is being dropped.

items.title: Part I.  GUI Interaction Model
items.hook: Deliverying events to uniquely identified panels.
items.description: We're getting the GUI panels reconfigurable, and we're getting events to the panels by their ID.

items.title: Part I aside: "Is 36KiB too much?"
items.description: Also, panel IDs should be separate from panel positions.

items.title: Discussing Threads and Memory in Python
items.description:
* Python will switch between threads not only for disk access, but also between ordinary operations.
* Having a dedicated disk read/write I/O thread is a good way to preserve smooth operation in a Python program.
* Also addressed a SASE system, so I don't have to match responses to requests: "Carry the continuation," or "Reply address along with the request."
